messages:
emma: heads up, noticed a tenant hit a bunch of 413s on /v1/embeddings this morning. logs show router split_count=6 for a single request.
raj: can you share a sample id?
emma: req=rt-9f3, tenant=data-labs. headers: Content-Length=950KB, X-Embed-Shape=[32,64,256,512].
tia: that's a crazy mixed shape. router currently splits whenever mixed_dims detected without considering total bytes. we should change priority: if bytes < 1MB prefer coalesce.
raj: agree. operationally we also need better telemetry: split_by_rule, split_shards, split_added_units. paging SRE.
infra-bot: metric change noted: add embed.split.rule, embed.split.shards, embed.split.added_units (tags: tenant, model).
emma: UX ask: in console request inspector show "why split" text and estimated added cost. product wants a simple explanation: "mixed dims -> split into 3 shards; est +0.9 units".
tia: runtime note: ensure subrequests inherit X-Cache-Key header to avoid KV misses. ping runtime team.
raj: quick mitigation: router should return 413 when split_count>5 instead of attempting >5 shards. also we can expose SDK preflight to catch this client-side.
emma: plan: metrics + router guard in 48h, console change in 1 week, SDK preflight in next client release. I'll open the issue and link here.
raj: also add a canary flag "split_conservative" so we can enable conservative behavior for 10% tenants first.
infra-bot: flag helper: POST /flags {"flag":"split_conservative","pct":10}
notes: No title. Messages as one continuous string with sender prefixes.
